table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	IssueDetail.IssueInvCode,   
	IssueDetail.Icode,
	IssueDetail.AlternateCustomICode,
	IssueDetail.Batch,   
	IssueDetail.Expiry,   
	IssueDetail.Gcode,   
	IssueDetail.Priority,   
	IssueDetail.Qty,  
	stock = 0.0000,
	totalstock = 0.0000, 
	balancestock = IssueDetail.balancestock,
	IssueDetail.Price, 
	IssueDetail.SalePrice,   
	IssueDetail.PurchasePrice, 
	IssueDetail.RowGroup,  
	IssueDetail.saleorderrowid,
	IssueDetail.AvgPrice,   
	IssueDetail.PackUnits,  
	IssueDetail.IssueUtn,  
	IssueDetail.sectcode,
	IssueDetail.IssRowID,
	IssueDetail.issuereqrowid,
	IssueDetail.MRPP,
	issueDetail.itemdescription,
	PackCapacity = 0.0000,
	PiecesInHand = issuedetail.PiecesInHand,
	TotalPieces = issuedetail.TotalPieces,
	claimable=issuedetail.claimable,
	claimablediscperc=issuedetail.claimablediscperc,
	receiptrowid=issuedetail.receiptrowid,
	AreaVolume = 0.00000000,
	PCS=0.000000,
	Cartons=SPACE(100),
	UnitWeight = 0.000,
	PackingFactor = 0.000
FROM 
	IssueDetail   
WHERE	
	( dbo.issuedetail.issueinvcode = :ar_IssueInvCode )
